turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Hi there, sorry for the wait. Can you tell me your full name and date of birth?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Kenji Nakamura, January 28th, 1992.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Thanks, Kenji. You sound pretty stuffed up. What's going on?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yes, this cold just won't quit. It started about ten days ago, runny nose, sore throat, the usual. I was actually getting better, and then like three days ago it got way worse.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Worse how?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: My face hurts, right here under my eyes, both sides, and it's like a pressure when I bend over. my upper teeth even ache, and the stuff coming out of my nose is thick and kind of green.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any fever?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I took it last night and it was one hundred, four.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Okay, any swelling or redness around your eyes or changes in your vision?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Bad headache, stiff neck.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Headache just the pressure kind, my neck's fine.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Any cough or a shortness of breath?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: A little cough from the drip at night, breathing's fine. what have you been taking ibuprofen like 400 milligrams a couple times a day and the afrin spray um I've kind of been using that for six days now okay we'll talk about the afrin any allergies to medicines penicillin I got hives as a kid my mom says I was covered good to know anybody sick at home my girlfriend Hana had the same cold first but she's totally fine now the dogs fine too he's the only one sleeping well.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Lucky dog, okay let me take a look. Temperature here is 99 .8, blood pressure 122 over 78, pulse 84 and oxygen is 98%. Your eardrums look normal, the inside of your nose is swollen and red and there's thick yellow green drainage. When I press over your cheeks is that tender?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Oh yes both sides.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Tender over both cheek sinuses not over the forehead. Throat is a little red, no pus on the tonsils. A couple of small tender lymph nodes in your neck. Lungs are clear.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: So is it a sinus infection?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: I think so. Most of these are viral, but because you got better and then worse again after a week, with fever and thick drainage, this looks like a bacterial sinus infection in your cheek sinuses. Since you're allergic to penicillin, I'm going to give you Darcocycline, 100 milligrams twice a day for seven days. Okay. Take it with a full glass of water and stay upright for a half hour after, and use sunscreen, it makes you sunburn easily. Now, the afrin, please stop it. After three days it causes rebound congestion and can actually make the stuffiness worse.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Oh, that explains a lot.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Instead, use a saline rinse twice a day, and start Fludacassone nasal spray, two sprays in each nostril once a day. You can keep the ibuprofen 400 milligrams up to three times a day with food.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Got it, can I get a note for work? I teach at Westbrook Middle School and I missed Monday.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Sure, I'll print one for Monday through today. If you're not starting to feel better in three days, or if you get swelling around your eye, trouble seeing, a stiff neck, or a really bad headache, call us right away or go to the emergency room.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Okay, should I come back?

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Only if it isn't clearing up. We'll call 555 -0129 if anything changes with the prescription, is that still right?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Yep, that's my cell.

turns.speaker: clinician
turns.text: Great, feel better, Kenji.
